title: chloris radiata var. beyrichiana
intro: Chloris radiata var. beyrichiana, commonly known as grass-leaved chloris, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Chloris radiata var. beyrichiana include its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory problems, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
